name: pi-embodied
description: Drive pi-embodied robots (LIBERO, ManiSkill, RoboCasa, Franka, Piper, UR5e, ...) from Claude Code: the robot's primitive manifest as MCP tools, with an operator gate on high-risk motions. Tools mode only; units, code mode, VDM, memory and evaluation stay in pi.

repo.title: pi-embodied checkout
repo.description: A built clone of LV-Robotics-Lab/pi-embodied (npm install && npm run build:offline); the MCP server and the hook run from its packages/embodied

robot.title: Robot
robot.description: The robot's manifest name: libero, maniskill, metaworld, robosuite, robocasa, robotwin, robolab, robodojo, genesis, behavior, humanclaw, franka, dual_franka, piper, ur5e

env_url.title: Env server URL
env_url.description: A running env server, http://host:port[#token=HEX]; leave empty to start one with serve_args

serve_args.title: Env server arguments
serve_args.description: Start the env server with these arguments (e.g. --suite libero_10 --task 0 --seed 0), using the deployment's python and services tree; ignored when env_url is set

deployment.title: Deployment
deployment.description: A deployment name in ~/.pi/agent/embodied.json (empty: default, or the only one)

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: high, low or raw; empty serves every non-privileged tool

capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.description: Comma-separated capabilities the env server was started with (sam3, ik, grasp, ...), for servers without a code.api

vars.title: Robot variables
vars.description: Semicolon-separated name=value[,value] the manifest's enums need, e.g. cameras=agentview,wrist;arms=

confirm_file.title: Operator confirm file (real robots)
confirm_file.description: A path only the operator writes to (outside the workspace and /tmp): before each motion on a real arm the operator writes the tool's name into it and the server consumes it; without it, and without PI_EMBODIED_MOTION_CONFIRMED=1 exported before claude starts, every motion on a real arm is refused
